visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a camouflage baseball cap and a black face mask walks through a brightly lit, modern airport terminal. He wears a grey hoodie under a black jacket. The background shows blurred passengers and signage. (2) Close-up shot of hands neatly folding light-colored garments and placing them into a grey hardshell Lojel suitcase. Other packed items like a red pill-shaped container and black clothing are visible inside the compartment. (3) The man walks towards the camera on a vibrant, rainbow-colored crosswalk at night. City lights and traffic signals in Taipei are visible in the background, creating a colorful urban atmosphere with high contrast. (4) Indoors, the man is shown eating a stick of dango. He holds the skewer and bites into a brown, glazed piece of the sweet snack. His eyes are closed in enjoyment as he chews. (5) In a clean, well-lit kitchen, the man drinks from a white and blue bottle of Meiji SAVAS protein drink. He tilts his head back, swallows, and then looks at the camera with a satisfied expression. (6) On a white surface covered with tissue, hands sort through stacks of paper currency, including colorful Taiwanese Dollar bills and Japanese Yen. A colorful EasyCard and a blue Suica card are placed next to the money. (7) A red Japanese passport is slid into a grey pocket inside a suitcase. The hands then close the suitcase and engage the mechanical latch, with the Lojel brand logo visible on the luggage surface. (8) The man holds up a black Alctron PF8 microphone with a blue circular filter. The shot transitions to show various filming accessories and a black camera bag sitting on a wooden shelf in an office. (9) Hands organize makeup products on a marble bathroom counter. A Dior foundation bottle, a Canmake powder palette, and other cosmetic items are arranged neatly. A pink Dior makeup bag sits in the background. (10) A hand picks up a crumpled grey plastic bag containing various health supplements. The bag is held up against a neutral wall, showing its textured, used appearance before being placed into a suitcase. (11) Close-up of a bathtub filling with water. A blue bath bomb is dropped in, creating swirling patterns of light blue and white foam as it dissolves into the clear water under bright bathroom lighting. (12) A hand holds a bottle of Kneipp 'Gute Nacht' bath soak in front of the bathtub. The label features a sleeping woman and lavender. A 'No. 1' sticker is visible on the product's packaging. (13) In a laundry room, hands place a white mesh laundry bag filled with clothes into a front-loading Hitachi washing machine. The machine has various Japanese control buttons and a digital display screen. (14) Several items of white and beige clothing, including a t-shirt with a yellow tiger graphic, hang on a drying rack inside a tiled bathroom. The man is seen sniffing a freshly washed white shirt. (15) The man closes his eyes and smiles while leaning into the hanging white shirt, expressing a sense of relaxation. A pink heart emoji overlay appears near his head to emphasize his positive mood. (16) A hand pours a clear liquid from a refill bottle into a white square ceramic diffuser. Then, several black scent sticks are inserted into the bottle's neck on a white bathroom vanity. (17) Hands pull a roll of white trash bags from a wooden drawer. One bag is separated and placed into a modern white smart trash can that opens its lid automatically when approached.

(5) [Variety]: 你們了解這種感覺嗎？ (6) [Subtitle]: 那就來介紹一下我回到日本後第一天的固定流程. (7) [Slogan]: 整理郵件. [Subtitle]: 首先就是要處理這些郵件. 一個月就這麼多. (8) [Slogan]: 整理郵件. [Subtitle]: 這麼說起來台灣的郵件量真的超少對吧？ (9) [Slogan]: 補充蛋白質. (20) [Slogan]: 整理行李箱. [Subtitle]: 這個塑膠袋已經用到皺巴巴了. (21) [Slogan]: 泡澡. [Subtitle]: 整理完後就要泡澡啦. (22) [Slogan]: 泡澡. [Subtitle]: 因為台灣家裡沒有浴缸, 所以這個絕對不能少. (23) [Slogan]: 泡澡. [Subtitle]: 這款入浴劑助眠效果超好. (24) [Slogan]: 泡澡. [Variety]: 推推！ (25) [Slogan]: 洗衣服. [Subtitle]: 隔天早上是洗衣服. (26) [Slogan]: 洗衣服. [Subtitle]: 貼身衣物我兩邊家裡都有放, 所以不用帶來帶去. (27) [Slogan]: 洗衣服. [Subtitle]: 台灣家現在是去投幣洗衣店. (28) [Slogan]: 洗衣服. [Subtitle]: 所以比較重要的衣服會盡量在日本洗. (29) [Slogan]: 洗衣服. [Subtitle]: 趁這時候加自己喜歡的柔軟劑. 脫水時間不要太長. (30) [Slogan]: 洗衣服. [Subtitle]: 這樣香味可以更持久, 心情更放鬆. (31) [Slogan]: 加室內擴香瓶. [Subtitle]: 以上就是我回日本當天的日常流程. (32) [Slogan]: 加室內擴香瓶. [Subtitle]: 如果有人想知道我「回國後一週的行程」的話. (33) [Slogan]: 裝垃圾袋. [Subtitle]: 留言猜猜看「我都做什麼」. (34) [Slogan]: 裝垃圾袋. [Subtitle]: 留言多的話我就會趕快拍給你們看喔！
